notes.title: Update notes for v1.0.6 (December 16)
notes.content:
Hey One Wheel Guys!

Another update is out, here are the changes:

[h2]v1.0.6[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug on the "The Treasure Is Mine" achievement
[*] Changed the way the coin balance is handled internally, and added info about coins found to the customize menu and the HUD
[*] Added one voice clip to the Streamer Guy skin
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes For December 15
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

There has been some updates in the past few days. Here are the changes:

[h2]v1.0.5 - Current Version[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a few bugs related to ragdoll physics and voices on several skins
[/list]

[h2]v1.0.4[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a new skin called Streamer Guy (homage to AvoidingThePuddle)
[*] Added japanese text support
[*] Fixed a bug where the fps limit slider would be disabled when the fps limit was enabled
[/list]

[h2]v1.0.3[/h2]

[list]
[*] Adjusted song playlists for a few levels
[/list]

[h2]v1.0.2[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a delay to the win screen to prevent accidental button presses
[/list]

[h2]v1.0.1[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added option to press circle to restart on the win screen
[/list]
